results.name: obsolete unfolded protein binding

definition.text: OBSOLETE. Binding to an unfolded protein.

results.comment: The reason for obsoletion is that this binding term should be replaced by an activity term such as protein folding chaperone (GO:0044183) or unfolded protein holdase activity (GO:0140309).

results.name: intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress

definition.text: The series of molecular signals in which an intracellular signal is conveyed to trigger the apoptotic death of a cell. The pathway is induced in response to a stimulus indicating endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and ends when the execution phase of apoptosis is triggered. ER stress usually results from the accumulation of unfolded or misfolded proteins in the ER lumen.

synonyms.name: apoptosis in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress
apoptosis in response to ER stress
intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway induced by endoplasmic reticulum stress

definition.text: A protein complex of the endoplasmic reticulum membrane that consists of IRE1 (Inositol-requiring enzyme-1), TRAF2 (TNF receptor-associated factor 2) and ASK1 (Apoptosis signal-regulating kinase 1, a MAP3K).

results.name: medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity

definition.text: Catalysis of the reaction: a medium-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a medium-chain trans-(2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons.

results.comment: While there is not universal consensus on the lengths of short-, medium-, long- and very-long-chain fatty acids, the GO uses the definitions in ChEBI (see CHEBI:26666, CHEBI:59554, CHEBI:15904 and CHEBI:27283).

results.name: medium-chain fatty acid catabolic process

definition.text: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a medium-chain fatty acid. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons.

results.comment: While there is not universal consensus on the lengths of short-, medium-, long- and very-long-chain fatty acids, the GO uses the definitions in ChEBI (see CHEBI:26666, CHEBI:59554, CHEBI:15904 and CHEBI:27283).

synonyms.name: medium chain fatty acid catabolic process
